content_brief.core_message: Unlock your fitness potential with personalized guidance from your AI Trainer, Nutritionist, and Gym Buddy, all within one powerful app.
content_brief.visual_style: Modern and clean flat design, similar to the input, utilizing a dark background with vibrant section colors (blue, green, orange) to highlight features.
key_elements: Dynamic illustrations or icons representing the AI Trainer, Nutritionist, and Gym Buddy functionalities.
Clear, concise text overlays that explain each feature's benefits.
elements_to_avoid: Generic health imagery without specific feature representation.
Overly complex graphics that detract from the app's usability.
content_brief.target_audience: Fitness enthusiasts and beginners who are tech-savvy and looking for personalized workout and nutrition guidance through an app.
content_brief.emotional_tone: Motivational and engaging, designed to inspire confidence and excitement about utilizing the app's capabilities.
content_angles: Showcase a specific feature of the AI Trainer, such as a personalized workout plan based on user goals.
Highlight the AI Nutritionist's meal planning feature, demonstrating how it tailors nutrition advice to individual preferences and dietary restrictions.

technical_specs.lighting: Consistent, flat lighting with no shadows for a clean digital look.
technical_specs.composition: Balanced layout with three distinct sections for each feature, ensuring easy readability and visual appeal.
